children: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - September 23, 2026) - BacTech Environmental Corporation

(OTCQB: BCCEF) ("BacTech" or the "Company"), a leader in commercial bioleaching for the circular economy, utilizing naturally occurring bacteria to recover valuable metals while stabilizing harmful elements such as arsenic, is pleased to announce that it will be attending the Centurion One Capital 4th Annual Bahamas Summit, a three-day invitation-only event taking place at the exclusive Rosewood Baha Mar Hotel from Monday, October 19th to Wednesday, October 21st, 2026, in Nassau, Bahamas.
Summit Details
Format: Presentations, Panel Discussions and 1 X 1 Investor Meetings
Presentation Dates: Tuesday, October 20th and Wednesday, October 21st, 2026
Time: 9:00 AM EDT - 4:00 PM EDT
Venue: Rosewood Baha Mar Hotel
For more information and registration details, please visit: Centurion One Capital - Bahamas Summit
About BacTech Environmental Corporation

BacTech Environmental Corporation is a leader in commercial bioleaching, utilizing naturally occurring bacteria to recover valuable metals while stabilizing harmful elements such as arsenic. The Company is advancing a fully permitted 50-tonne-per-day bioleach facility in Tenguel-Ponce Enríquez, Ecuador, and is developing its proprietary Zero Tailings™ critical minerals recovery technology in Sudbury, Canada. On September 1, 2026 the Company announced its first tailings project in Kazakhstan that combines its commercial BACOX technology with that of Zero Tailings.
BacTech trades on the Canadian Securities Exchange
, the OTCQB (OTCQB: BCCEF), and the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (FSE: 0BT1).
